main_text.p: Syr. Sufficere, Sufficienter habere, Acquiescere, Sufficiens esse: Absumi, Consumi, Deficere Thren. 2. 11. Sic convenit cum פֿפּ. Pahel ספּ, & ex altera forma, סופּק Plaudere, complodere: sufficere, sufficiens esse; sufficienter, sufficientiam largiri, suppeditare: Item Perficere, absolvere: Absolvi, consumi. Pahel אסתפק Idem.
ספיקא Ch. Idem, Genes. 31.29. in Jon.
ספוקלטור Spiculator, Carnifex. Plur. ספוקלטוריא Speculatores, quod melius legeretur, ספוקלטוריא, Gen. 37. v. ult. in Jon. sicut & in Targ. Hierof. ספוקלטריא pro ספוקלטריא.
ספר Heb. Numerare, annumerare, recensere, narrare. Pahel ספר Ch. Tondere, radere, abradere, Sic Syr. Act. 18.19. Ethpah. Tonderi, 1. ad Corinth. 11.6.

ספרא ספר Ch. Syr. Liber, libellus: epistola. Item Metonymice, Litterae, Doctrina, Eruditio, Hinc Qui non novit litteras, id est, Illiteratus, Act. 4.13. Litterae multae faciunt te insanire, Act. 26.24. Plur. ספרין

page.notes: Several Hebrew and Syriac words are printed with pointing and marks that are only approximately reproduced here; Syriac and Hebrew forms are transcribed as closely as the scan allows, and the Syriac line for "Syr. Vacuus" and "Inaniter" are uncertain.
